m01_latency_plus1.description: DIVIDE ends at step 23 (24 divide steps, done one cycle late)

m02_latency_minus1.description: DIVIDE ends at step 21 (22 divide steps, done one cycle early, wrong value)

m03_ties_toward_zero.description: exact ties (2R == L) round toward zero for both signs

m04_neg_ties_up.description: negative exact ties round toward +inf (half up in signed terms)

m05_neg_off_by_one.description: negative results use ~q + s instead of ~q + !s (off by -1)

m06_sign_from_bit18.description: sign latched from sum_in[18] instead of sum_in[19]

m07_start_restarts.description: a start while busy restarts the datapath (busy-ignore dropped for the datapath)

m08_shift_beats_done.description: a shift in the completion cycle overrides the new result

m09_shift_rotates.description: shift rotates result[11] into bit 0 instead of zero fill

m10_reset_keeps_result.description: synchronous reset does not clear result

m11_reset_keeps_done.description: synchronous reset does not clear done (done holds through reset)

m12_reset_no_abort.description: reset does not abort a running division (state only reset when idle)

m13_latch_always.description: LATCH_DENOMINATOR=1 samples the denominator every cycle (behaves like 0)

m14_remainder_not_cleared.description: remainder is not cleared at load (holds its old value through IDLE)

m15_ovf_neg_2048.description: CHECK_INVALID=1 flags the valid result -2048 as overflow (rare value)

m16_rare_point.description: rare value: result corrupted only for sum_in = 12345 with denominator = 678 (accept-time point)

m17_rare_maxL.description: rare value: rounding increment lost when the divisor is 4095

m19_busy_low_in_round.description: busy is low in the ROUND cycle (busy = state == DIVIDE)

m20_done_sticky.description: done is not cleared after its pulse (stays high until reset)

m23_carry_bit8_lost.description: the round/sign incrementer drops the carry out of bit 7

m24_start_during_reset.description: a start in a reset cycle is accepted (reset no longer beats start)

e01_latch_on_start.description: saved_divisor loaded only at accept (state == IDLE && start)

e02_negate_form.description: signed_result written as negative ? -(q + s) : q + s

e03_compare_form.description: subtract computed by >= and the remainder by a separate subtraction

e04_magnitude_neg.description: magnitude written as a two's complement negate of the full sum

e05_step_hold_in_idle.description: step cleared only on the accept edge (holds while idle without start)

e06_done_explicit.description: done written as a single assignment from the ROUND state
